tasks.instruction: Pick the mug from the cabinet, place it under the coffee machine dispenser, and press the start button.
requirements: The mug's centre is within 4 cm (horizontally) and 10 cm (vertically) of the coffee machine's mug spot under the dispenser.
The coffee machine is on: it switches on the first time the gripper touches its start button and then stays on.
The gripper's grip site (between the fingertips) is more than 25 cm from the mug's centre: let go and move the hand away.
The gripper's grip site is also more than 15 cm from the start button. A "centre" is a body's origin; "touches" means a MuJoCo contact.
tasks.source: RoboCasa @ 756598a (v0.2; MIT), robosuite 1.5.1, MuJoCo 3.2.6; environment source

tasks.instruction: Pick the cans from the counter and place them in their designated side in the cabinet.
requirements: Both cans are entirely inside the cabinet (all eight corners of its bounding box within the interior, with a 5 cm tolerance).
Each of them is on the side of the can already in the cabinet: its distance to that can, times 2, is less than its distance to the other (non-can) item in the cabinet (centre to centre).
The gripper's grip site (between the fingertips) is more than 25 cm from each can's centre: let go and move the hand away. A "centre" is a body's origin; "touches" means a MuJoCo contact.
